title: Concept: Environment file served from the web root
description: A dotenv file with application keys and database credentials in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The file holds the application key and database password in clear text, which is usually enough to forge sessions and read the database directly.
applicability: Deployments that render a dotenv file with application keys and database credentials into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The file holds the application key and database password in clear text, which is usually enough to forge sessions and read the database directly.
